01_transcript_viewport.md.notes: LbeEvent vocabulary for commands/stdout/stderr/detached exists. No scroll offset, PageUp/Down/Home/End, follow-tail preservation, or command detail view implemented.

02_model_picker.md.notes: UserRequest::SelectModel exists with catalog validation in MockLbeWrapper. Model catalog rendering shown in status bar. Missing: interactive picker with row selection, Up/Down navigation, Enter submits, Esc closes, error surfacing for invalid selections.

03_checkpoints_restore.md.notes: Full LbeEvent vocabulary for checkpoints (created, comparison, restore requested/blocked/restored) exists with transcript rendering. Missing: CheckpointCompare/Restore UserRequest contracts, checkpoint list/detail/comparison/results rendering.

04_sessions.md.notes: Session lineage, status projection, and SessionStatus/Origin types exist in LbeSnapshot. /session panel exists as placeholder. Missing: session list/detail projection, replacement of local-only /new reset with runtime request contract.

05_background_processes.md.notes: Command/detached-event vocabulary exists with transcript rendering. /processes panel not implemented. Missing: command ID/state/source/latest activity/exit-code/log-availability projection and detail view.

06_provider_configuration.md.notes: Provider types (ProviderId, ProviderHealth, AuthState, ProviderProjection, ProviderConfig, ProviderCapabilities) and mock catalog exist. ProviderCatalogDiscovered/Health/Auth events exist. Missing: configure/validate/remove request contracts, provider selection and base URL editing, credential state rendering without exposing raw secrets.

07_tools_registry.md.notes: /tools panel exists but shows only a not-connected placeholder. ToolRisk and ValidationStatus types exist. LbeEvent::ToolRequested/Started/Completed/Failed exist. Missing: typed tool registry projection, name/description/owner/risk/enabled/approval-requirement rendering, read-only detail view.

08_evidence_browser.md.notes: /evidence panel exists but shows only a not-connected placeholder. No evidence record types defined. Missing: typed evidence record projection, ID/type/source/origin/timestamp/status/summary rendering, evidence-to-execution/tool/session reference links.

09_receipts_browser.md.notes: /receipts panel exists but shows only a not-connected placeholder. Receipt IDs appear in transcripts (LbeCompletionAccepted). Missing: structured receipt projection, receipt ID/execution ID/authorization/execution/validation/completion state rendering, evidence reference exposure.

10_mcp_surface.md.notes: /mcp panel exists but shows only a not-connected placeholder. Missing: typed MCP server projection, server identity/transport/connection-state/health/tool-count rendering. Configuration/connect actions reserved as wrapper requests.

11_terminal_compatibility.md.notes: Palette uses RGB colors; no NO_COLOR fallback. Logo uses unicode block characters; no ASCII fallback tokens. Missing: NO_COLOR handling, ASCII fallback tokens, CJK/emoji/combining-character cell-width verification, long path/model name testing.

12_plain_cli_mode.md.notes: No --no-tui command path exists. All output goes through Termina/ratatui. Missing: --no-tui flag definition, stdout-for-results/stderr-for-diagnostics contract, meaningful exit-code contract for automation.

13_lifecycle_acceptance.md.notes: Unit tests exist for logo geometry, animation reveal order, context meter, and minimum-size fallback. Missing: PTY smoke tests for normal quit/Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D/panic exits, alternate-screen/cursor/raw-mode restoration verification, resize and suspend/resume behavior testing.

14_responsive_acceptance.md.notes: Minimum-size check (60x18) exists in unit tests. Below-minimum fallback renders honest message. Missing: pinned render tests at 60x18 and 80x24 for populated states, narrow-width panel tests for provider/model/doctor/session, long workspace path/model name overflow testing, deterministic truncation verification.
